description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kalubovila, Dehiwala D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520806
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title amendments under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing modifications to land parcel registrations, including changes to encumbrances, extents, classifications, and ownership interests for multiple land parcels in the Colombo District. The content falls squarely within land and property-related matters as defined for Type 4 classification, with no government personnel or structural changes present.
